degenerate.constant: the row's +5 bp probability has a range of at most 1e-9 over the scored days of a refit block
degenerate.all_zero: the probability is 0 on every day of the block
degenerate.never_flag: the cut-off in force on the block is infinite
degenerate.always_flag: the cut-off in force on the block is at most the block's smallest probability, so every day of the block flags
